1019.desc: When hypnotized zombies die, they explode, dealing damage equal to 150% of their max HP to nearby zombies

1020.desc: After a plant is healed, they heal for 5% of their current health per second for the next 3 seconds (unstackable)

2002.name: Transcendence
2002.desc: You can upgrade 1 upgradable Epic Modifier

2003.name: Apex Defender
2003.desc: If a Plant Type has dealt the highest total damage on the field, its attacks deal an extra 30% of original damage as true damage

2004.name: Trigger Happy
2004.desc: After firing 50 times (25 for catapults), plants gain an unlimited attack speed for 1s

2005.name: Life Steal
2005.desc: Plants gain 1% life steal, applied to the plant with the lowest HP percentage on the field

2006.name: Ambush Tactics
2006.desc: The longer since a zombie was last damaged, the more damage it takes from the next hit. <1s: Damage * (1 + 9t); ≥1s: Damage * (10 + 9ln(t))

2007.name: Corrupting Touch
2007.desc: All zombies are now under the Corruption effect: each time a zombie is damaged, the next instance of damage to that zombie is increased by 5% (stacks infinitely)

2008.name: Purification
2008.desc: You can remove 1 non-mini-boss Zombie Modifier from the View Modifier menu

3000.name: Eternal Bulwark
3000.desc: When Cherrizilla and Obsidian Tall-nut (or their subspecies) are both present, Cherrizilla/Garlizilla no longer has a maximum Toughness cap, and Obsidian Tall-nut/Obsidian Mine gains a 90% damage reduction

3001.name: Astral Convergence
3001.desc: If there are at least 10 Magnetars and 10 Helios Cabbages on the field, the Mini Sun summoned by the Helios Cabbage will never disappear and deal 5× damage, and will keep summoning Helios Meteors

3002.name: Total Firepower
3002.desc: Gatling Cherrybomber now spreads its shots evenly across three lanes with sine and cosine trajectories, and Infernal Squashwood and its subspecies triggers a full-field Jalapeno effect if it can't plant a Spicy plant

3003.name: Celestial Beacon
3003.desc: When there are at least 10 Magnetars and 10 Selene Cabbages on the field, Selene's summoned Mini Moon will not disappear, while each Magnetar and Selene will charge a beam into the Mini Moon, which redirects it to target the zombie with the most amount of HP

3004.name: Event Horizon
3004.desc: Hail melons from Maelonstrom's Nebula Rifts now deal 6× damage and create Singularities, and Cosmo-pult always lob Ultimate Black Holes. When an Ultimate Black Hole collapses, it also detonates all Singularities to further increase its own damage

3005.name: Heaven's Wrath
3005.desc: Click on a reloaded Vulcannon while holding an Epic Twin Inferno-nut with the Glove to make all reloaded Vulcannon on the field perform a synergized attack towards the sky. Every 8th Inferno Shell shot calls down an Inferno Meteor dealing 80× damage, decimating all zombies on the screen

3006.name: Bullet Hell
3006.desc: When Cherrybomber Drone is placed above Epic Gatling Frenzy-shroom, the more they attack, the more bullets they fire in the next volley. This bonus decays after they stop attacking. (WARNING: Will lead to cancerous amounts of projectiles!!)

3007.name: Ultranova
3007.desc: Photon Splitter can lock onto any Atomheart Plantern ahead (click to select) to charge it. When energy exceeds 10k, its brightness increases, dealing heavy damage and slowing zombies in its radius. At 100k, collapses into a black hole and explodes, devastating all zombies on screen. (WARNING: Contains flashing lights)

3008.name: Little Miracle
3008.desc: When Litter-pult and SP Gatling Icicle-shroom are planted on the same tile, the latter's projectiles split one additional time. Both plants' normal and special projectiles inherit some properties from each other's shots. (WARNING: Will cause lag)

3009.name: Elemental Fury
3009.desc: Doominator now spawns Obsidian Tall-nut Iceclaw Zombies, Napalm-shroom's main projectile will split into an additional Obsidian Melon; dealing AoE damage equal to the melon's original attack power which doubles for each ice and fire plant present on the lawn, and a synergy between the Enflamed and Chill debuffs is unlocked.

4000.name: Abyssal Chibi
4000.desc: Summons an Abyssal Chibi to fight for you (replaces current Pet). His hammer smash damages both nearby plants and zombies, grants damage reduction to affected plants, and deals increased damage to zombies based on nearby plants' HP. Hammer effects scale with XP level.

4001.name: Striker Junior
4001.desc: Summons a Striker Junior to fight for you (replaces current Pet). Every 3s, he moves to the plant with the lowest HP percentage and rallies the area, healing nearby plants and increasing damage taken by zombies. Rally effects scale with xp level

4002.name: Prototype Iceborg
4002.desc: Summons a Prototype Iceborg to fight for you (replaces current Pet). She targets the highest-HP lane and fires ice projectiles. Damage increases based on the number of chilled/frozen zombies, and gains infinite pierce & bonus xp if the Iceborg Executrix is on the field. Projectile damage scale with xp level

4003.name: Baby Jill
4003.desc: Summons a Baby Jill to fight for you (replaces current Pet). Every 15s, she performs a random attack: summons high-tier hypnotized Clown-in-the-Box zombies per lane or throws out explosives (lane-wide or global). Explosion damage scales with xp level

4004.name: Mini Pozeidon
4004.desc: Summons a Mini Pozeidon to fight for you (replaces current Pet). Every 5s, he throws his trident ahead, which pierces and damages zombies with explosions. If the mini-boss Pozeidon is present, throws 4 tridents in each lane every 10s instead

4005.name: Young Duke
4005.desc: Summons a Young Duke to fight for you (replaces current Pet). Rapidly fires iron pea bullets forward, and every 20 seconds she summons a column of mini warhorses to charge at the zombies and create Zombie Souls of the ones they hit. If the mini-boss Archduke Deathrider is present, her summoning interval is halved. (WARNING: Will cause MASSIVE lag!!)

4006.name: Imperor Hatchling
4006.desc: Summons an Imperor Hatchling to fight for you (replaces current Pet). Every 10 seconds, he will transform a certain number of zombies (based on XP level) into Chicken Jockey or Hydrofowl Zombies. If the mini-boss Imperor's Ark of the Duck is present, the maximum number of transformations is doubled.

4007.name: Skyglider Mecha
4007.desc: Summons a Skyglider Mecha to fight for you (replaces current Pet). Increases damage from plant-side Jack-in-the-Box explosions, and fires an explosive at zombies every 1.5s (every 3rd attack is fired across each row). If the mini-boss Skystrider Mecha is present, the pet's attack interval is halved.

5000.name: Goliath Slayer
5000.desc: Plants deal +100% to Mini-bosses and Bosses

6008.name: Infernal Squashwood Mastery II:

10003.name: Accelerator
10003.desc: Increase the speed of (1+n) random plants, where n is the number of Plant modifiers you currently have

10004.name: Totem of Undying
10004.desc: The next time zombies reach the house, it is ignored for 3s and knock all zombies back to the start

10005.name: Supply Drop
10005.desc: Obtain a Pumpkin Chest that has many seed packets for Epic Odyssey Fusions (no Subspecies)

10006.name: Deus Ex Machina

10007.name: Winter's Chosen One
10007.desc: Gain a Super Blizzard Commando with +1500% damage and HP, +1000% speed, and gain an extra Coldsnap Bean

10008.name: Heat Riser
10008.desc: Gain a random Odyssey plant. Each new zombie wave, it gains +25% damage, +25% HP, and +10% speed

10009.name: Pact of Corruption
10009.desc:
Gain a Shroomageddon seed packet. Planting it ACCEPTS the challenge:
Summon 3-6 random Odyssey zombies in each lane (yeah, ALL possible ones)
Defeat them all to unlock the Modifier "Corrupting Touch"

10011.name: Force Shield
10011.desc: All plants gain 50 + (2% max HP) shield per second

10012.name: The Last Ditch
10012.desc: When you have 20 or more plants on the field, zombies reaching the house no longer results in game over, but causes all plants to have 1/3 chance to die instead

10013.name: Pact of Promotion
10013.desc:
Gain an Omni Pumpkin seed packet. Planting it ACCEPTS the challenge:
The number of zombies in the next 20 waves are doubled
Get through and all plants on the Omni Pumpkin's tile will be promoted to Tier 3

10014.name: Lawn Sweeper
10014.desc: Unleash all current lawnmowers and restore one full column of them

10015.name: Delay of Fate
10015.desc: You will not game over if you manage to kill the zombie reaching your house within 1.5s

10017.name: Shared Roots
10017.desc: Upon gaining a second copy of any plant for the first time, you receive an additional seed packet of that plant

10018.name: Evolution Catalyst
10018.desc: Using the glove to move a plant onto another plant of the same type and tier upgrades it by 1 tier

10019.name: Fortune Reforged

12007.name: Ascend: Gravity

12008.name: Ascend: Penetration

12010.name: Ascend: Chaos Beam

12011.name: Ascend: Ricochet

12012.name: Ascend: Veterancy

12013.name: Ascend: Density

12014.name: Ascend: Hemorrhage

23.name: Zenith Radiance

26.desc: Napalm-shroom & Magma-shroom: Charging speed and max charge ×3

43.name: Holy Fire
